note: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Shows the format and a lane-consistent shape; every number is a placeholder, not a recommendation. Copy into ../rate-limits.json and replace the values once the team has picked them.

frxUSD.note: Amounts are whole frxUSD on every chain (Tempo's 6-decimal TIP-20 included). Each spoke has one lane, to and from Fraxtal; Fraxtal has one lane per spoke.

*.note: Every chain not listed below, and the fields a listed chain does not set: outbound 2M/day, inbound 10% above it so delayed deliveries that bunch up still clear.

fraxtal.note: Hub. The default (inherited from *) covers the spoke lanes; the bigger lanes get per-peer limits that mirror the far side's own limits below.

solana.note: Solana's own limits live in its OFT program's peer config (Squads), not here. Outbound to Solana inherits the default.

tempo.note: Example of the emergency bypass: limits stay configured but are not enforced while true.
